blind_target.evidence_quote: Here, we describe the replication of the Goldsmiths Musical Sophistication Index (Gold-MSI) in a sample of 346 university students, drawn from both a school of music and a department of psychology.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The original approach to modeling the Gold-MSI was followed as closely as possible, and the results replicated well overall.
